shipping.html:

Where we deliver

We currently deliver to addresses in the United Kingdom only.

Delivery options and costs

  • Standard – £3.49, usually 3–5 working days. Free on orders over £30.

Dispatch times

Orders placed before 1pm Monday–Friday are normally dispatched the same working day. Orders placed after 1pm, at weekends or on bank holidays are dispatched the next working day.

Tracking

You'll receive an email with your tracking number once your order has been dispatched.

Lost or damaged parcels

If your parcel hasn't arrived within 10 working days of dispatch, or arrives damaged, please contact us and we'll sort it out.

returns.title: Returns and refunds
returns.html:
Template text — review it, fill in the [bracketed] details and have it checked before you go live.

Your right to cancel

Under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 you can cancel your order within 14 days of receiving it. For hygiene and safety reasons we can only accept returns of products that are unopened and in their original sealed packaging.

How to return an item

  1. Contact us with your order reference within 14 days of delivery.
  2. Send the unopened item back to: [Your returns address].
  3. We'll refund you within 14 days of receiving the return, to your original payment method.

Unless the item is faulty or we sent the wrong item, return postage is at your own cost.

Faulty or incorrect items

If something arrives damaged, faulty or isn't what you ordered, contact us within 30 days and we'll replace it or give you a full refund, including postage.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.html:
Template text — review it, fill in the [bracketed] details and have it checked before you go live.

{{storeName}} ("we", "us") is committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what we collect and why, in line with UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.

Who we are

The data controller is [Your legal business name], [registered address]. You can contact us at {{contactEmail}}.

What we collect

  • Order information – name, delivery address, email, phone number and the items you bought.
  • Payment information – card payments are handled by Stripe. We never see or store your full card details.
  • Messages – anything you send us through our contact form.

Why we use it

  • To process, deliver and support your order (performance of a contract).
  • To meet our legal and accounting obligations (legal obligation).
  • To answer your enquiries (legitimate interests).

Who we share it with

We share only what is needed with: Stripe (payments), our delivery partner (e.g. Royal Mail) and our hosting provider. We never sell your data.

How long we keep it

We keep order records for 6 years for tax purposes, and contact messages for up to 2 years.

Cookies

Our site uses your browser's local storage only to remember what's in your cart. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. Stripe sets its own cookies on its checkout page to prevent fraud.

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or object to how we use it, by emailing {{contactEmail}}. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).

About these terms

These terms apply to all orders placed on this website, operated by [Your legal business name] ("{{storeName}}"). By placing an order you agree to them.

Products

We make every effort to describe and show products accurately. Packaging may vary slightly from images. Products are for external use only. Read the leaflet supplied with each product, and ask a healthcare professional if you are unsure whether a product is suitable for you.

Prices and payment

All prices are in pounds sterling (GBP) and include VAT where applicable. Delivery charges are shown at checkout. Payment is taken securely by Stripe when you place your order.

Your order

Your order is an offer to buy. A contract is formed when we email you to confirm dispatch. We may decline or cancel an order (with a full refund) if a product is out of stock, a pricing error has occurred, or we have concerns about the order.

Discount codes

Discount codes can't be exchanged for cash, can't be combined, and may be withdrawn at any time.

Delivery, returns and refunds

See our Shipping and delivery and Returns and refunds policies.

Liability

Nothing in these terms limits your statutory rights as a consumer or our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales.
